name: Face Culling Voxel Meshing
aliases: Voxel Mesh Generation with Face Culling
Voxel Chunk Mesh Generation with Face Culling
definition: A fast and simple meshing algorithm that produces a single quad for every visible face of a block.
summary: Face Culling Voxel Meshing generates a static triangle mesh by emitting geometry only for voxel faces adjacent to empty space, differing from Greedy Meshing by producing one quad per exposed face rather than merging coplanar surfaces.
